legal_form: קרן פתוחה, קרן מחקה (open tracking fund under the Joint Investment Trust Law 1994; bought and redeemed at the unit price through a distributor, not traded on the exchange, ETF-04); קרן בלתי מוגבלת בניירות ערך חוץ; currency-hedged (מנוטרלת מט"ח): exposure code 4A, foreign-currency exposure up to 10% of net assets in absolute value; the fund's aim is the S&P 500's change in US dollars without the dollar/shekel exchange-rate change (p. 1 'מטרת הקרן'); units of 1 ₪ par value; kosher approval. Trustee: מזרחי טפחות חברה לנאמנות בע"מ. Short name on Maya: 'הראל מחקה SP500 ממ'. REPLICATION: swap and futures: mainly unfunded swaps on the index or its components and/or futures and synthetic contracts on the index (annual report https://mayafiles.tase.co.il/rpdf/1725001-1726000/P1725343-00.pdf, p. 2, 'הדרך שבה הקרן תנוהל': 'בכוונת מנהל הקרן לחשוף את הקרן למניות הנכללות במדד בעיקר באמצעות עסקאות החלף שאינן במימון שנכס הבסיס שלהן הינו המדד או מרכיביו ו/או באמצעות חוזים על המדד'; read 2026-10-25).

fixed_management.notes: Fixed management fee: p. 1 'דמי הניהול הקבועים בקרן: 0% מהשווי הנקי השנתי הממוצע של נכסי הקרן'. Load (שיעור ההוספה): 0% of the unit price. Expense table (chapter ה'): fixed management fee 0.00% in each of 2022 to 2025; total expenses 0.32% in each year. Prospectus published on Magna on 28.4.2025, reference 2025-03-029778 (not opened; Magna returns 403 to scripts). ISIN read on the fund's Maya page (https://maya.tase.co.il/he/funds/mutual-funds/5127527, field 'ISIN', read in Chrome on 2026-10-24); the page states its fund data is collected from the manager's filings and not audited by TASE. The annual report itself prints no ISIN.

tracking_difference_12m.notes: Not printed as one number. Chapter ג' prints for 2025 the fund's redemption-price return 15.32% (standard deviation 18.35) against 'מדד S&P 500' 17.43% (standard deviation 18.63), the index in US dollars, which is the hedged fund's tracking asset; earlier years: 2024 21.86% against 24.16%; 2023 23.60% against 25.70%; 2022 -21.78% against -18.52%. The difference, which includes the cost of the currency hedge, is not computed here (data-update rule). Hedged variant: the shekel return is meant to follow the dollar index, so the 2025 gap to the unhedged tracking asset of the (4D) funds (2.61% in shekels) is not comparable. Added 2026-10-25: the third-party page the report points to (chart.bursagraph.co.il / fundscenter.co.il, 'Funds Center' by Guideline) publishes the 12-month tracking difference under ETF-07(e), but states 'אין להפיץ בכל דרך כלשהי ... את הנתונים המוצגים באתר', so its figures are not copied here; founder decision pending.

median_spread.notes: Not applicable: an open tracking fund is bought and redeemed at the unit price computed from net asset value (MF-09), with no exchange spread; the load on purchase is 0% (p. 1). The distributor may charge its own buy and sell commission (p. 1 footnote; MF-26).
